backbone: CEPII Gravity V202211 existing-country dyad-year panel

direction.interpretation: tourism flow j -> i is linked to cultural-goods trade i -> j

tourism_missing_rule: Preserve missing. Do not convert absent UN Tourism observations to zero.
comtrade_zero_rule: Convert absent sparse product-partner values to zero only when UN Comtrade reporter-year availability confirms reporting for iso3_d/year. Otherwise preserve missing.
hofstede_time_rule: Time-invariant pair measure; merge by iso3_o + iso3_d only.
baseline_choice_policy: Master build does not choose between v_ttl_lb/v_ttl_ub, tourists/visitors, or cd6_ge4/cd6_strict/cd4_ks. It preserves alternatives and creates sample flags.
